description: Fetch one earthquake by event ID: a USGS ID, or an EMSC ID (an origin date and seven-digit sequence, e.g. "20190706_0000043"). Returns the same normalized event a search result carries. For a USGS event it adds a projection of the analysis products only the single-event response holds: PAGER impact alert and report link, ShakeMap peak intensity and ground motion, DYFI felt-report totals, the moment-tensor focal mechanism, landslide and liquefaction alerts, origin quality (azimuthal gap, station count, location uncertainty, depth type), and finite-fault rupture dimensions. Product groups are omitted when no projected field is available — a small automatic event typically carries only origin quality, while a large reviewed one has most of it. Opt into more with include: alternative origin solutions, magnitude solutions, phase arrivals, or the USGS aftershock forecast; a requested group that is not returned is listed in unavailable_includes. EMSC publishes none of these products, so an EMSC event has no detail and lists every requested group as not_published. Event IDs appear in the "id" field of earthquake_get_feed and earthquake_search_events results; a USGS event's associated_ids are also accepted.

event_id.description: USGS event ID, e.g. "hv74966427" or "us6000sznj", or EMSC event ID, e.g. "20190706_0000043". Found in the "id" field of earthquake_get_feed and earthquake_search_events results.

include.description: Optional groups: origins (every contributed origin solution, no extra request), magnitudes and arrivals (one shared phase-data download; every arrival of the preferred origin, nearest first), aftershock_forecast (one extra request). Omit for the default response.

name: earthquake_get_event

aftershock_forecast.description: USGS Operational Aftershock Forecast; probabilities change with each update.

advisory_window.description: Window USGS headlines in its advisory, e.g. "1 Week".

created.description: ISO 8601 UTC time the forecast was issued.

expires.description: ISO 8601 UTC expiry of the forecast.

next_update.description: ISO 8601 UTC time of the next scheduled update; absent once updates stop.

above_mainshock.description: Chance of an aftershock as large as the mainshock; absent when unpublished.

probability.description: Probability (0–1) of an aftershock at or above the mainshock magnitude.

count_p95_max.description: Upper bound of the 95% count range.

count_p95_min.description: Lower bound of the 95% count range.

probability.description: Probability (0–1) of at least one aftershock at or above it.

start.description: ISO 8601 UTC window start (the forecast issue time, not now).

arrivals.description: All phase arrivals of the preferred origin, sorted by distance ascending.

items.description: One phase arrival joined to its pick.

azimuth_deg.description: Azimuth from epicenter to station, degrees.

location.description: SEED location code as published; "" and "--" both mean blank.

phase.description: Phase name, e.g. P, Pn, S.

time_weight.description: Weight of the arrival time in the location.

detail.description: Projected USGS analysis products. Absent when no projected field is available; absence does not mean impact was zero.

dyfi.description: Felt-report summary. Absent without projected fields.

map_url.description: URL of the rendered DYFI intensity map image.

max_cdi.description: Maximum Community Decimal Intensity derived from those reports (0–12 scale).

responses.description: Public DYFI (Did You Feel It?) report count.

finite_fault.description: Finite-fault rupture model for large events; absent without projected fields.

model_url.description: URL of the finite-fault rupture model file.

rupture_length_km.description: Modeled rupture length along strike, in kilometers.

rupture_width_km.description: Modeled rupture width down dip, in kilometers.

ground_failure.description: Secondary-hazard alert levels. Absent without projected fields.

losspager.description: PAGER assessment; fatality/economic-loss brackets are in report_url, not this projection. Absent without projected fields.

report_url.description: URL of the PAGER one-page PDF summary of estimated impact.

moment_tensor.description: Focal mechanism; absent without projected fields.

nodal_plane_1.description: First nodal plane; either plane may be the fault.

dip.description: Fault plane dip in degrees from horizontal (0–90).

rake.description: Slip direction, degrees (-180..180): ~90 reverse, ~-90 normal, ~0/180 strike-slip.

strike.description: Fault plane strike in degrees clockwise from north (0–360).

nodal_plane_2.description: Auxiliary nodal plane; seismic data alone cannot distinguish the true fault.

dip.description: Fault plane dip in degrees from horizontal (0–90).

rake.description: Slip direction, degrees (-180..180): ~90 reverse, ~-90 normal, ~0/180 strike-slip.

strike.description: Fault plane strike in degrees clockwise from north (0–360).

origin.description: Location-quality metrics for the preferred origin; absent without projected fields.

azimuthal_gap_deg.description: Largest station azimuthal gap, degrees; >~180 means poorly constrained location.

depth_type.description: How the depth was set, as published, e.g. "from location" or "operator assigned" (fixed, not solved for).

num_stations_used.description: Number of seismic stations used in the location solution.

review_status.description: Origin review state published by its network.

shakemap.description: ShakeMap modeled ground-motion summary. Absent without projected fields.

code_version.description: ShakeMap producer code version reported by USGS.

intensity_map_url.description: URL of the rendered ShakeMap intensity map image.

max_mmi.description: Maximum modeled shaking intensity across the ShakeMap grid (Modified Mercalli).

max_pga.description: Maximum modeled peak ground acceleration, in g (fraction of standard gravity).

max_pgv.description: Maximum modeled peak ground velocity, in cm/s.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `event_deleted`: USGS reports that the requested event was deleted. `not_found`: No USGS or EMSC event matches the provided event_id. `source_unavailable`: The USGS or EMSC event API returns a 5xx, serves HTML, or is unreachable. `source_timeout`: The USGS or EMSC event API did not answer before the request deadline. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

alert.description: PAGER estimated impact; null without an assessment or for EMSC.

associated_ids.description: Other network IDs USGS lists for this event, in upstream order; earthquake_get_event accepts them. Absent when USGS lists none, and for EMSC events.

auth.description: Authoritative agency/network code (EMSC auth or USGS net); absent if unpublished.

cdi.description: Maximum DYFI Community Decimal Intensity (0–12); null if uncomputed or unsupported (EMSC).

depth_km.description: Hypocenter depth in km; null if unmeasured.

detail_url.description: URL to fetch the full GeoJSON detail record. Present in USGS list responses.

event_certainty.description: EMSC classification certainty: known (asserted), suspected, unknown, or unreported. Suspected is not confirmed. Absent for USGS and unrecognized EMSC codes.

event_type.description: QuakeML classification (earthquake, quarry blast, explosion, etc.). EMSC codes decode to USGS names; unknown codes pass through verbatim. Certainty is separate. Absent if unpublished; either catalog includes non-tectonic events.

event_url.description: USGS event page URL. Present for USGS events only.

felt.description: DYFI (Did You Feel It?) response count; null if no USGS reports or source has no DYFI (EMSC). Null does not mean unfelt.

magnitude.description: Preferred magnitude; null if not computed (title: "M ?").

magnitude_type.description: Magnitude type (ml, mww, mw, mb, etc.).

mmi.description: Maximum ShakeMap Modified Mercalli intensity (0–12); null without a ShakeMap or for EMSC.

significance.description: USGS significance (0–2000+), combining magnitude, felt reports and PAGER; null if uncomputed or for EMSC.

source_catalog.description: Solution catalog, e.g. EMSC-RTS (real-time, subject to revision). Absent for USGS.

status.description: Review state: automatic (unverified), reviewed (analyst checked), or deleted. Null if unpublished (EMSC); such solutions remain unverified and subject to revision.

tsunami.description: USGS tsunami flag: 1 for large oceanic events, 0 otherwise; null if unpublished (EMSC). Not a warning or evidence of a tsunami; check NOAA tsunami.gov for alerts.

updated.description: ISO 8601 UTC time this record was last updated.

magnitudes.description: Magnitude solutions from the preferred phase-data product, in document order.

evaluation_mode.description: QuakeML evaluation mode: manual or automatic.

is_preferred.description: True for the document's preferred magnitude.

type.description: Magnitude type, e.g. Mww, mb, Ml.

origins.description: Every origin product, preferred first. Present when requested and published.

items.description: One origin solution from an origin product.

depth_type.description: How the depth was set, as published, e.g. "from location" or "operator assigned".

event_id.description: Contributing network's ID for the event.

is_preferred.description: True for the origin USGS prefers (listed first).

magnitude_type.description: Magnitude type, e.g. mww, mb, Mi.

minimum_distance_deg.description: Distance to the nearest station, degrees.

review_status.description: Review status as published by the network.

source.description: Network that contributed this origin product.

unavailable_includes.description: Requested groups not returned, with the reason. Absent when all were returned.

items.description: One requested group that was not returned.

reason.description: not_published: the event has no product for it. fetch_failed: the product exists but could not be fetched or parsed.
